title: benchmarks-synthetic-data-generators: a benchmark suite for synthetic RDF data generators
description: Benchmark suite for synthetic RDF data generators. Every generator runs in its own Docker container; a single command (python3 main.py --all) builds the images, generates the datasets, computes the metrics and renders the charts for the controllability (E2), conformance (E4) and FHIR case-study (E5) experiments. Generated datasets are not included; they are reproducible with the command above.
